description: List known vulnerabilities for a software package (optionally a specific version) via OSV. Ecosystems: npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, rubygems, nuget, composer, pub, hex.

ecosystem.description: Package registry to look in. One of: npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, rubygems, nuget, composer, pub, hex.

name.description: Exact package name as published in that registry, e.g. lodash for npm, requests for pypi.

version.description: Optional; if given, only vulns affecting that version are returned

name: package_vulnerabilities
title: Package Vulnerabilities
